reference_note: User-provided Sref=49 m^2 and MAC=4.629 m are retained as references; they are not replaced by values derived from this single trapezoidal panel. Their different values may reflect a different reference definition or geometry not included here; no reconciliation is assumed.
coordinate_note: Station eta is fractional distance from the supplied root to tip. Station y_m is global spanwise Y (negative on this left panel); profile CSV y_m is instead local wall-normal distance. Global XLE and chord are linearly interpolated between the supplied endpoints.

blasius_numerics.normalization_note: Velocity fractions are divided by the computed f'(10), only after checking abs(f'(10)-1)<=1e-8. No larger correction is allowed.

temperature_note: Static temperature 288.15 K is an explicit default used to infer dimensional tunnel speed, density and pressure. With constant-property Blasius profiles at specified Re_MAC, nu/U=MAC/Re_MAC fixes the sizing lengths independently of this temperature default.
profile_laminar_confirmation: laminar_confirmed=true describes the explicitly assumed undisturbed Blasius model. It is not experimental confirmation that the wing stays laminar.
